data.name: [🌊] Escape Tsunami For Brainrots!
data.description:
Welcome to Escape Tsunami For Brainrots! 🌊

🏃 Run fast and grab Brainrots!
🌊 Don't let Tsunami catch you!
💸 Upgrade your Brainrots and earn more money!
🏗️ Upgrade your base for more slots!

🎰 Use Spawn Machines to roll new Brainrots!
🎁 Open Lucky Blocks for surprise loot!
✨ Can you unlock the legendary Infinity Brainrots...?
